limitations: Current 6a861556 source, matched saved condition bank, low full hollow shell FP64/Q10/s8, original final budgets. Rigid/live/policy include timed metrics, contact/radius changes, observation, reset and maintenance. Recovery-only repeats a frozen actual snapshot and is explicitly not a changing-contact rollout. Policy is FP32 network inference rollout, not RL training. Four scopes run sequentially on one GPU. Single seed B1024 checkpoint; wider batches, more seeds, dynamic tail attribution and optimization plateau remain pending. No physical convergence claim.
